parameters.content:
## 1 · Version-controlled inputs
Target: adhammo/engineering-journalist, main. Push this directory first.
Import engineering-journalist.json, then select GitHub credentials on GitHub HTTP nodes and Gemini on Google Gemini Chat Model.
Config, research prompt and HTML template are fetched from ONE Git commit per run. Edit those files and push: the next run reads them.
Code node sources are separate .js files. After code changes, npm run build and reimport. No remote JavaScript evaluation.
GitHub Pages: main / root. Weekly trigger disabled initially.

## 2 · Evidence → triage → exact publication approval
Read includes; Ignore excludes; Investigate holds for follow-up. Eight review slots support max_items <=8.
Run-specific evidence, decisions, draft and approval are committed under runs/<run-id>/.
review.html is the latest draft; index.html changes only after final approval. The published bytes are fetched by the approved commit SHA and checked against the captured draft.
Resume form links remain in the n8n execution; never publish those links. Reviewer names are audit labels, not authenticated identity.
Keep one run in flight: latest index.html follows completed-approval order.

## 3 · 30 minutes: automate and fail safely
5 min: inspect config and prompt fetches. 8 min: research and evidence. 7 min: both human gates. 8 min: failures. 2 min: recap.
Pin Gemini output for exercises: malformed JSON, missing grounding, future publication date, duplicate source URL, missing human decision, final Reject, draft-blob mismatch.
Errors stop before production overwrite. Empty search results require coverage review. Search grounding is not independent claim verification.
Investigate is recorded for manual follow-up, not automatically researched. Duplicate filtering is per run; historical runs are retained, not automatically diffed.
